opportunities.title: Validate a same-day cancellation recovery workflow
opportunities.audience: independent restaurant operators with late cancellations
opportunities.task_gap: Operators have perishable table inventory and limited time to reach nearby diners.
opportunities.subject_entry: Test whether the idea can publish a verified same-day opening and route an interested diner to the restaurant's existing booking flow.
opportunities.expected_action: Interview five operators and run one manual concierge test before building automation.
opportunities.counter_review: No direct counterexample was captured in this small sample; this remains a validation gap.
risk_boundaries: Do not claim proven demand, revenue recovery, or platform access.
